title: Research candidate
description: One proposed external data source, as written by the research-sources skill / research-analyst routine. Describes the source, not an implementation.

slug.description: Matches the candidate JSON filename and the memo slug.

gap.description: The specific gap this fills, in this project's own terms (e.g. a hardcoded assumption, a missing metric).

granularity.description: e.g. tract, ZCTA, county, MSA, state, national, point-in-time (no geography).

license.description: What's confirmed about reuse terms, and what's still open.

cost.description: Confirmation of free, any API key/registration needed, any rate limit.

history.description: How far back usable history goes.

proposed_kind.description: Likely app.sources.base.Source `kind` if implemented (boundaries/neighborhood/sales/listings/sold_check), or 'not a Source — other mechanism' if it doesn't fit the per-neighborhood-metric model.

correlation.description: Quantitative evaluation result, or 'not computed — app/research/evaluate_series.py does not exist yet'.
